name: claudemods
description: Darrell's Claude Code mods and skills

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Context window as a stacked bar above the prompt; toggle with /context-bar

plugins.name: prompt-nav
plugins.description: A slim side rail of your previous prompts; hover for the full text, press to jump. Toggle with /questions

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: 5-hour and weekly plan usage meters with reset times, beside the context bar; toggle with /usage-bar

plugins.name: memory-pane
plugins.description: A pane of the CLAUDE.md, memory and settings files in play, with token costs, and a toast when Claude saves to memory; toggle with /memory-pane
